protocol.primary_metric: Mean squared error per value coordinate, averaged within independent trial
protocol.primary_comparison: development-selected ridge vs development-selected softmax per recall scenario
protocol.multiplicity: Holm across all reported recall model/scenario comparisons; Bonferroni paired t and paired percentile-bootstrap intervals
protocol.scope: Encoded-operator analysis only; no trained Mamba-3/Transformer/LM or TPU speed claim
protocol.holdout_policy: Independent named seed streams for development, evaluation and resampling. Select each method on development loss only. Retain every evaluation result. No sequential stopping.
